title: The Emergence of Reproducibility and Consistency in Diffusion Models
tldr_zh: 同一初始噪声 + 确定性采样器下，不同架构/训练的扩散模型输出几乎相同；噪声↔样本耦合是数据内在、可跨模型复用的对象
tldr_en: Independently trained diffusion models map the same initial noise to nearly the same image under deterministic sampling; the noise-sample coupling is a property of the data.
